Task video description:
A close-up laparoscopic view shows a surgical instrument entering from the left to manipulate and dissect a thin, translucent, web-like membrane of tissue spanning the center of the frame. The background consists of glistening, moist, pinkish-red visceral tissue with visible fine vasculature and scattered small red spots. The instrument, featuring a metallic shaft and a fine, pointed tip, carefully grasps and pulls the membrane, causing it to stretch and tear, revealing more of the underlying reddish tissue. As the dissection progresses, the membrane is progressively cleared, and the camera shifts slightly, revealing a second, thicker, greyish instrument entering from the right side to assist in the retraction and cutting process. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct surgical lighting that creates strong specular highlights on the wet surfaces, and the overall color palette is dominated by shades of red, pink, and white.
